reason: Index enhancement requires stock-relative-to-SPY forecasts. Subtract the contemporaneous SPY label from each observed stock label to remove market-wide quarter effects; unchanged six prior-price features and all11 seeds.
feature_rules: Strictly preceding market-session adjusted-price ratios; each feature window requires one source and complete positive prices.
missing_policy: Training-only feature medians plus missing flags; no row filter on issuer status or feature coverage.
rf: 200 trees per seed, depth6, minimum leaf20; arithmetic average of ALL11 validation and inference predictions.
comparison_estimators: Fixed XGB200/depth3/lr0.05; LGBM200/leaves15/lr0.05; same as archived SEC7.
model_selection: Lowest purged prior-four-quarter validation MSE; no test-period portfolio-return selection.
portfolio: Primary:80%SPY+20%equal-weight top5% by validation-selected model; quarterly. RF ensemble is reported as a comparator.
window: May1 2020 to Sep30 2025 with SPY fallback before June1; also report June30 descriptive slice.
costs: 10bps each traded dollar; stress20bps and one-session delay.
labels: Observed log stock wealth minus observed log SPY wealth over the SAME endpoints, only used after purged realization dates. Original stock targets retained separately; unknown CVRs stay unknown.
known_rights_policy: Dated public nonmarket-right facts applied during trading; developed after unvalued exposure in earlier run; same fixed rule in this benchmark-relative replay.
adoption: Final private review of a transparently developed strategy; independent numerical audit completed; no untouched-holdout claim.
